column2: Pirates raided the harbor town at night and took gold from the market.
column3: 海盜在夜裡襲擊港口小鎮，從市場搶走黃金。
column5: raid 諧音「瑞得」，瑞得很快衝進去搶了就跑

column2: The family paid a large sum to ransom their kidnapped son.
column3: 這家人付了一大筆錢贖回被綁架的兒子。
column5: ransom 像 random 加 s：用錢換回人，不是隨便給

column2: Years of war ravaged the countryside, leaving fields empty and homes broken.
column3: 多年戰爭蹂躪了鄉村，田地荒蕪，房屋殘破。
column5: rav 像 rave 狂亂，狂風掃過一片荒蕪

column2: If the pain recurs, call your doctor right away.
column3: 如果疼痛再度發生，要立刻打電話給醫生。
column5: re 再 + cur 跑：跑回來再一次

column2: Factories refine crude oil into gasoline and other useful products.
column3: 工廠把原油提煉成汽油和其他有用的產品。
column5: re 再 + fine 精細：再弄得更精細

column2: The store promised to refund my money because the shoes were damaged.
column3: 商店承諾退還我的錢，因為那雙鞋有損壞。
column5: re 回 + fund 資金：錢回到你手上

column2: The class rehearsed the play every afternoon for two weeks.
column3: 全班連續兩週每天下午排練這齣戲。
column5: re 再 + hearse：一再練習，hear 聽台詞再說

column2: The rider reined in his horse as they came near the bridge.
column3: 騎士接近橋邊時勒住了馬。
column5: rein 是韁繩，諧音「雨」，拉韁繩讓馬停

column2: Workers reinforced the old bridge with steel beams to make it safer.
column3: 工人用鋼樑加固老橋，讓它更安全。
column5: re 再 + in + force 力量：再灌入力量

column2: Please relay my message to the manager as soon as she returns.
column3: 經理一回來，請立刻把我的訊息轉達給她。
column5: relay 像接力賽 relay race，一棒傳一棒

column2: My brother relishes spicy noodles and always asks for extra chili.
column3: 我哥哥很愛吃辣麵，總是多要辣椒。
column5: relish 諧音「勒利許」，吃得好愛的感覺

column2: The heavy fog rendered the road almost invisible to drivers.
column3: 濃霧使駕駛幾乎看不清路。
column4: render someone speechless (使某人說不出話)
column5: render 接形容詞：把某人弄成某種狀態，如 speechless

column2: The government repressed the protest and arrested many of the leaders.
column3: 政府鎮壓了抗議並逮捕許多領導者。
column5: re 往回 + press 壓：往下壓回去

column2: Don't retaliate when someone teases you, because anger solves nothing.
column3: 有人取笑你時不要報復，因為生氣解決不了問題。
column5: re 回 + talia 像 tally 相抵：以牙還牙算回去

column2: The diver retrieved the lost ring from the bottom of the pool.
column3: 潛水員從泳池底部找回了遺失的戒指。
column5: re 回 + trieve 找到：找回來，retriever 就是黃金獵犬會叼回來

column2: Classmates ridiculed his strange haircut, but he just laughed it off.
column3: 同學嘲笑他奇怪的髮型，但他只是一笑置之。
column4: ridicule an idea (嘲笑一個想法)
column5: ridicule 諧音「瑞滴糗」，被人笑到出糗

column2: Angry fans rioted outside the stadium after the unfair result.
column3: 不公平的結果出爐後，憤怒的球迷在體育場外暴動。
column4: riot in the streets (在街頭暴動)
column5: riot 諧音「來亞特」，大家一起衝出來鬧事

column2: The earth rotates once every twenty-four hours around its axis.
column3: 地球每二十四小時繞著地軸自轉一圈。
column5: rot 轉：rotate 像 rotation 旋轉木馬

column2: Wearing a helmet safeguards cyclists against serious head injuries.
column3: 戴安全帽能保護騎車的人免於嚴重頭部傷害。
column5: safe 安全 + guard 守衛：安全的守護者

column2: The studio scripted the famous novel as a ten-episode TV drama.
column3: 製作公司把這部名著改編成十集的電視劇劇本。
column4: script a film (撰寫電影劇本)
column5: script 是劇本，當動詞就是把故事寫成劇本

column2: Free samples seduced shoppers into buying more than they needed.
column3: 免費試用品誘使購物者買下超出所需的東西。
column5: se 離開 + duce 引導：被引到別的方向

column2: The lab technician sequenced the genes of the tiny virus.
column3: 實驗室技術員為這種微小病毒的基因排序。
column5: sequence 序列，當動詞就是把東西排成序列

column2: Our cat sheds fur all over the couch every spring.
column3: 我們的貓每年春天都在沙發上到處掉毛。
column5: shed 諧音「瞎的」，毛瞎的掉滿地

column2: A teenager was caught shoplifting candy from the corner store.
column3: 一名青少年在轉角商店偷糖果時被抓到。
column4: shoplift from a store (在店裡行竊)
column5: shop 店 + lift 拿走：從店裡順手拿走

column2: After the scandal, many voters shunned the mayor and refused to speak to him.
column3: 醜聞之後，許多選民躲著市長，不肯與他說話。
column5: shun 諧音「順」，順著人群走開避著他

column2: A red light on the dashboard signifies that the engine is too hot.
column3: 儀表板上的紅燈表示引擎過熱了。
column5: sign 記號 + ify 使：這個記號代表某個意思

column2: The new app simplifies the process of ordering lunch at school.
column3: 這個新應用程式簡化了在學校訂午餐的流程。
column5: simple 簡單 + ify 使：使變簡單

column2: I skimmed the article quickly to find the date of the concert.
column3: 我很快瀏覽那篇文章，想找音樂會的日期。
column5: skim 像溜冰滑過水面，眼睛也滑過頁面

column2: The angry man slanged the referee loudly after the match.
column3: 賽後那個生氣的男人大聲用粗話罵裁判。
column5: slang 當名詞是俚語，這裡是用粗話罵人

column2: The mayor slashed the budget for new roads by half.
column3: 市長把新道路的預算削減了一半。
column5: slash 像「斯拉西」，刀一揮斜斜砍下去

column2: The clerk slotted the coin into the machine and pressed the button.
column3: 店員把硬幣投進機器的投幣孔，然後按下按鈕。
column4: slot a coin (把硬幣投入投幣孔)
column5: slot 是狹長孔，動詞是放進那個孔

column2: On weekends, the rich tourists slummed in the old harbor district for fun.
column3: 週末時，有錢的遊客為了好玩逛去舊港區的貧民窟。
column5: slum 是貧民窟，當動詞就是去那種地方

column2: His sudden answer smacked of pride, and nobody liked the tone.
column3: 他突如其來的回答帶著幾分傲氣，沒有人喜歡那種口氣。
column5: smack 諧音「死麥克」，嚐到一點味道

column2: She smothered the small campfire with sand before leaving the camp.
column3: 離開營地前，她用沙子把小營火悶熄。
column5: smother 像 mother：被媽媽的大棉被悶住

column2: The man tried to smuggle rare birds across the border in boxes.
column3: 那個男人試圖把稀有鳥類裝在箱子裡走私過邊境。
column5: smuggle 諧音「死摸狗」，偷偷摸摸帶過去

column2: Hunters snared a rabbit in a wire loop hidden in the grass.
column3: 獵人用藏在草叢裡的鐵絲圈套捕到一隻兔子。
column5: snare 像 snake 加 scare：蛇一樣悄悄把你套住

column2: The older boys sneered at his old shoes, but he ignored them.
column3: 年紀較大的男生嘲笑他的舊鞋，他不理會。
column5: sneer 像 sniff 加 ear：鼻子哼一聲，一臉瞧不起

column2: Oil prices soared last month after the sudden winter storm.
column3: 突如其來的冬季風暴使油價上個月暴漲。
column5: soar 諧音「搜」，飛得好高，一搜就上去了

column2: Shy students often learn to socialize better after joining a club.
column3: 害羞的學生加入社團後，通常更懂得與人交際。
column5: social 社交 + ize 動詞：做社交的事

column2: A warm bath and soft music soothed the crying baby to sleep.
column3: 溫熱的澡和輕柔的音樂哄得哭鬧的寶寶睡著了。
column5: soothe 諧音「舒適」，讓人舒適就安慰了
